nodes.label: OpenAPI 3.0.3 Specification
nodes.description: OpenAPI spec for IoT Platform API. Rate limits: api-read 120/min, api-write 60/min, auth-login 5/min. Security schemes: bearerAuth (Sanctum), deviceKey (X-Device-Key header). Endpoints: Health (/api/health), Auth (login, register, forgot-password, reset-password, verify-email, me, logout, resend-verification), IoT (GET /api/iot/sensors, POST /api/sensors/{sensor}/readings, POST /api/ingestion/events), Sensors (CRUD + readings + export + latest-readings + series + graph-zones), Devices (CRUD + status + sensors + sensor-list), Alerts (list, active, unresolved, resolve-all, detail, resolve), AlertRules (CRUD), Dashboard (metrics, preferences), Profile, Admin (metrics, users, roles, labs, sensor-types, device-types, config alerts/general/email, system-info, internal metrics).
nodes.rationale: The API contract definition. Maps every endpoint to its access level and request/response schemas. Critical for understanding the complete API surface and its authorization boundaries.
